messages:
alyssa: Morning — async checkin
What I did: pushed RBAC fix for /v1/model routing and updated route priority so enterprise traffic prefers the dedicated pool.
Blockers: seeing intermittent 429s in the canary when token rate spikes >1200/s; unclear if it's rate-policy or batching overflow.
Today: instrument per-route token-bucket metrics and open a small change to rate-policy service. ping @sam for token-bucket config review.

sam: saw the 429s earlier too, might be KV cache saturation causing slow path and bursts to trip the bucket. can you add a trace id to a failing request so I can correlate logs?
I'll review the rate-policy PR — have a branch 'rl-fixes' ready.

matt: rolled forward a small throttle tweak on staging this morning; short-run numbers look better. pushed extra logs to cloudwatch under /staging/gw/throttle if anyone wants to spot-check.
If you want I can enable longer retention for the window we need.

ciara: quick Q — does the dedicated pool selection honor max_concurrent? iirc requests can still route there even if the pool is cold which causes cold-start latency spikes. we should consider a fallback policy to hosted when pool is cold.
Tagging @jordan to add a visual for cold starts on the canary dashboard.

jordan: can add a heatmap for pool cold starts. quick query I plan to add:
```
select count(*) from requests where pool="dedicated" and cold_start=true group by 1m
```
I'll wire that into the canary board under 'pool-health'.

sam: @alyssa can you paste the JSON we use on staging for the token-bucket policy? want to double-check burst_size. will circle back in ~1h to review PR.

alyssa: pasted snippet from staging config:
```
{
  "policy": "token_bucket",
  "rate": 1000,
  "burst": 200,
  "scope": "route:/v1/model"
}
```
that's what's active rn. planning to try a temporary bump if metrics look safe.

matt: noted — deploy-bot showed a retry storm at 03:12 UTC yesterday for the canary: multiple 502s followed by retries after auth timeouts. might be an auth gateway reconnect issue causing cascaded retries.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: rl-fixes -> staging @ 2026-03-16T03:40:12Z :white_check_mark:

ciara: update — local repro of reconnect fixed by auth lib bump. will open PR to bump lib in prod; need to coordinate short maintenance window for the rollout. @alyssa please advise on timing.

alyssa: thanks. next steps: i'll open PR for per-route metrics and propose a short experiment to bump burst to 300 for a few hours during off-peak. cc @sam @matt for quick review. if no objections by EOD i'll merge and schedule a 1h canary run.

sam: +1 from me for the experiment, assuming we have the new metrics live before the bump.

matt: +1, and i'll watch the retry logs during the canary.

alyssa: perfect — i'll post the PR link when ready and add a short checklist for monitoring.
